description: Single-file 2048: 4x4 grid, keyboard arrows and touch/swipe, correct merge rules (one merge per tile per move), animated tile spawn/slide/merge transitions, score with best score in localStorage, undo of the last move, win at 2048 with keep-playing.

criteria: game_2048_model_01.html is one self-contained 2048 (no libraries): a 4x4 grid driven by arrow keys and pointer/touch swipes, move logic that slides and merges exactly once per tile per move and only merges equal values, random 2/4 spawns with correct probabilities, smooth CSS transitions for spawn/slide/merge rather than a static redraw, score with best score persisted in localStorage, undo of the last move (at least one level), game-over detection, and the win screen at 2048 with continue playing. No instant un-animated grid flips and no illegal merges.
